AVIATION COMPONENT SUPPLIER AGREEMENT

1. COMPONENT DELIVERY
The Supplier shall deliver the component within 10 days after acceptance.

2. PAYMENT
The Airline shall pay the invoice on the first Business Day of each month.

3. COMPONENT INSPECTION
The Manufacturer shall inspect the component every 500 flight cycles.

4. LIABILITY
The Supplier's liability shall be capped at EUR 1 million except for fraud, confidentiality and indemnification.

5. DELIVERY PENALTY
Late delivery incurs a penalty of EUR 120,000.

6. TERMINATION
The Supplier may terminate following an uncured payment default after 10 days.
